name: ipinfo-enricher
description: Look up IP addresses from query results on IPinfo (country, ASN, network owner, and hosting or VPN flags on paid plans), and show the answers as extra columns.

permissions.reason: Read the values you choose to enrich

ipinfo-enricher.api.description: Which IPinfo API to use. "lite" works with the free plan: country and network owner (ASN). "lookup" needs a Core plan or higher and adds city, region, network type and the hosting, anonymous (VPN, proxy, Tor), anycast and mobile flags.

ipinfo-enricher.maxLookupsPerRun.description: At most this many NEW values are looked up per run; answers already found are kept for the next run.

ipinfo-enricher.requestsPerMinute.description: How fast to look values up. IPinfo does not throttle, but paid plans have a monthly quota.

ipinfo-enricher.maxSecondsPerRun.description: A run stops starting new lookups after this long and returns what it has; run it again to continue.
